title: Romantically Challenged
production_companies: Candy Bar ProductionsBonanza ProductionsWarner Bros. Television
premise_summary: Romantically Challenged is an American sitcom television series that aired on ABC from April 19, 2010, to May 17, 2010. The series is set in Pittsburgh and was created by Ricky Blitt, who is also the show's head writer. It stars Alyssa Milano. On May 16, 2010, ABC officially canceled the series; six episodes were produced, but only four aired.
